text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san, Ardan-san. Are you really sure 
you want "that" for your birthday 
present...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The extra-large birthday parfait that 
only an Umamusume on her birthday can 
order... That is something one can only 
savor today, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... It's such a massive portion, I'm 
not sure Ardan-san and I can finish it 
all, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Those who fear the gate shall never reach 
the goal," after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It feels like, 'Let's just give it a shot 
and see!' Even if we fail, that should 
still be fun in its own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Those are wonderful words. 
Without looking back at the past, nor 
worrying about the future, sprinting 
through this very moment—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's really nothing fancy, but I'm 
glad if you like it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head out and eat right 
away. The extra-large birthday parfait 
awaits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, 'Those who fear the gate 
shall never reach the goal'♪
